title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
四人是从小玩到大的关系。不是亲人，胜似亲人。此时看到米娜没事，他们每一个人都发自内心的高兴。年纪最小的阿哈努高兴道：“太好了米娜姐姐，我们刚才还在担心你呢。“放心吧，阿哈努，我现在可是被神灵恩赐的巫女，厉害着呢，这次是特意过来救你们的……”也只有在在几个亲密的伙伴面前，米娜才露出了少女俏皮的一面。她朝几人抬眼笑了笑，让他们离自己近一点，随即抬起了手。嘭！嘭！！！埋在警察局地下的水管，在这一瞬间同时破裂。里面的大量自来水像是听到指令了一样，从水管里喷射出来，以极快的速度汇聚到米娜所在的房间，形成了一个由高速旋转水流形成的蓝色龙卷，带着米娜还有阿哈努三人冲破警察局的房顶，消失在空中。……“还好，我做出了正确的决定！”十几分钟后，借故外出的费城警察局局长丹尼尔·奥特洛赶回来，看着警察局的一片狼藉，不怒反喜。他觉得现在那位印第安女巫小姐就没有理由针对他了。毕竟他已经尽到了自己最大的努力。而这件事情会不会影响他的职位和之后的晋升？？？丹尼尔·奥特洛一点都不担心。祖上就是老米字旗的他认识好几位宾夕法尼亚州的高官和议员，这点事情只要招呼一声，不会掀起任何风浪。他还是费城警察局那个说一不二的局长，光辉的履历上没有任何污点。“对了，局长，还有一件事，调查组那边要求我们派出足够的警力，去美国第一国家银行那里维持秩序，有太多人在那打卡拍照了。”这时，警局里的的心腹手下提起了另外一件事情。丹尼尔·奥特洛闻言脸色当即黑了下来。“该死，你怎么不早说？”……美国第一国家银行附近。虽然这里天空中的异象早就消失了，但看热闹的吃瓜群众非但没有减少，反而越来越多。大家都是冲着身上火焰还没熄灭的巨人尸体来的。毕竟像这种珍贵的装逼机会，可能仅此一次，想要在自己朋友们面前，又或者社交媒体上装一波的人们不想错过。

即使帮派成员看人多已经提价到一百美刀，大家也都捏着鼻子认了。这种热闹的景象直到费城警察局派了大量警员过来维持秩序，才渐渐平息。但还是有一些付了钱、还没拍到照的美国民众对此感到不满，非但没走，反而聚在一起向警察们发起了抗议。“巨人是大家的，你们警察不能独占他。”“没错，这是属于全体美国公民的财产，神圣的公民财产权不容侵犯......”“跟巨人拍照是我们的自由！！”同时是拿着枪，围观群众们不敢向那些凶神恶煞的帮派分子大声说话，但在这些警察面前，他们却是一个比一个大声，甚至还敢顶着防暴盾往前挤。这种闹剧直到调查组叫来了消防队，用高压水枪对着他们喷射才停止。而身上残留火焰被浇灭的巨人尸体，也被四架黑鹰直升机用特种合金钢索吊起，运往距离费城市区不远的哈里斯堡空军基地。这座基地始建于1898年，最早是作为陆军维修站和补给中心使用的。后来随着信息化发展越来越快，美军意识到电子战的重要性，该基地的驻扎部队换成了第193特种作战中队。这是一支装备了洛克希德.马丁公司生产的EJ-130J电子战飞机，和大量攻击性无人机，执行赛博作战任务的信息化部队。基地负责人就是之前跟威廉.斯蒂芬通过话的欧内斯特·约瑟夫上校。他此刻在自己办公室里有点慌。特别是听说威廉.斯蒂芬死状凄惨，被印第安女孩米娜用一种古老的刑罚凌迟而死时，他感觉自己已经半只脚踩在死神门口了。后半只脚什么时候踏进去，取决于那个女孩什么时候想到自己来报仇。“不行，我得想想办法。”做惯了高高在上的基地负责人，在军队里的前途也一片光明，欧内斯特·约瑟夫还是第一次有这种命运不被自己掌握的无助感。他在房间里焦躁地走来走去，突然脑海中灵光一闪，想到了一个好主意。他记得那个印第安女巫，好像还有一个脑癌晚期的母亲在医院里。如果他能掌握这个印第安老女人的话。。。。。。想到这，欧内斯特·约瑟夫马上拿出手机，打给了位于费城郊区的长老会医院。然后得到了一个对他来说非常糟糕的消息。就在五分钟前，脑癌晚期的琳达突发急症，在手术室里被主治医师宣告抢救无效死亡。随后没过多久，对方的尸体在医院停尸间不翼而飞。
content_en:
The four of them have been in a relationship since childhood.Not a relative, but better than a relative.Seeing that Mina was fine at this time, each of them was happy from the bottom of their hearts.The youngest Ahanu said happily: "That's great, sister Mina, we were worried about you just now. "Don't worry, Ahanu, I am now a witch gifted by the gods. I am very powerful. I came here to save you this time..." Only in front of a few close friends did Mina show her playful side. She raised her eyes and smiled at a few people, asking them to get closer to her, and then raised her hand. Bang.!Bang!!The water pipes buried under the police station burst at the same time.As if hearing the order, a large amount of tap water sprayed out of the water pipes and converged into the room where Mina was located, forming a blue tornado formed by the high-speed rotating water, taking Mina and Ahanu through the roof of the police station and disappearing into the air... "Fortunately, I made the right decision!"Ten minutes later, Philadelphia Police Commissioner Daniel Outlaw, who had gone out for an excuse, rushed back. Looking at the mess in the police station, he was not angry but happy. He felt that now the Indian witch lady had no reason to target him. After all, he had done his best. And would this matter affect his position and subsequent promotion??? Daniel Outlaw was not worried at all. His ancestors were old rice characters.He knows several high-ranking officials and congressmen in Pennsylvania, so this matter will not stir up any trouble.He is also the uncompromising chief of the Philadelphia Police Department, and there is no stain on his glorious resume."By the way, chief, there is one more thing. The investigation team asked us to send enough police to maintain order at the First National Bank of the United States. There are too many people checking in and taking pictures."At this time, the confidant in the police station mentioned another matter. Daniel Outlaw's face immediately darkened when he heard this. "Damn it, why didn't you tell me earlier?"...Near the First National Bank of the United States. Although the strange phenomena in the sky here have long since disappeared, the crowd of people watching the melons has not decreased, but has increased in number. Everyone came for the giant corpse whose flames have not been extinguished. After all, this precious opportunity to show off may only happen once, and people who want to show off in front of their friends or on social media don't want to miss it.

Even though the gang members had raised the price to $100 due to the large number of people, everyone still held their noses and accepted the offer.This lively scene gradually subsided until the Philadelphia Police Department sent a large number of officers to maintain order.However, some Americans who had paid but had not yet taken photos were dissatisfied with this. Instead of leaving, they gathered together to protest against the police.“The giant belongs to everyone, you police can’t monopolize him."Yes, this is property that belongs to all American citizens. The sacred civil property rights cannot be violated..." "It is our freedom to take pictures with giants!"!"While holding guns, the onlookers did not dare to speak loudly to the vicious gang members, but in front of these police officers, they were louder than the other, and even dared to push forward with riot shields. This farce did not stop until the investigation team called the fire brigade and sprayed them with high-pressure water cannons. The remaining flames on their bodies were extinguished.The giant's body was also lifted by four Black Hawk helicopters using special alloy steel cables and transported to the Harrisburg Air Force Base, not far from Philadelphia.This base was first built in 1898 and was first used as an army maintenance depot and supply center.Later, as information technology developed faster and faster, the US military realized the importance of electronic warfare, and the base was stationed.The formation was replaced by the 193rd Special Operations Squadron.This is an information-based force equipped with EJ-130J electronic warfare aircraft produced by Lockheed Martin and a large number of offensive drones that perform cyber warfare missions.The person in charge of the base is Colonel Ernest Joseph, who had spoken to William Stephen before.He was a little panicked in his office.Especially when he heard that William Stephen died in a tragic manner and was tortured to death by an ancient punishment, he felt that he had already stepped on the door of death with one foot.It depended on when the girl thought of revenge."No, I have to think of a way."Accustomed to being a superior base leader, and with a bright future in the army, Ernest Joseph felt this helpless feeling for the first time that his fate was not in his control. He walked around the room anxiously, and suddenly a good idea came to his mind. He remembered the Indian witch, and it seemed that there was a mother with terminal brain cancer in the hospital. If he could grasp this sealWhat the old woman said... Thinking of this, Ernest Joseph immediately took out his cell phone and called the Presbyterian Hospital in the suburbs of Philadelphia.Just five minutes ago, Linda had an emergency and was pronounced dead in the operating room.Not long after, the other party's body disappeared in the hospital morgue.
